branch_decision: The full measured-total LOD cannot be multiplied by the generic film spatial chain: the resulting response differs from the measured total by up to 0.22462. With the B/G/R curves mapped to RGB explicitly, measured/legacy is positive and below unity on all frozen frequencies, satisfying only the necessary condition for a positive residual blur. Freeze P5N to test whether a finite positive PSF can realize this residual; until then neither full measured replacement nor residual composition is active.
retained_boundary: A later measured-total selection replaces forward scatter, development adjacency and dye diffusion unless P5N proves an explicit residual composition. Scanner MTF remains separate. P3 long-range backing return remains closed unless an excess-response audit proves non-overlap.
claim_ceiling: Small-signal spatial-budget attribution for one manufacturer total-film MTF curve family; no identified internal decomposition, roll/process/scanner calibration, photographic value or product promotion.
